query:
UPDATE pages
         SET search_text = COALESCE($2, search_text),
             content_updated_at = GREATEST(content_updated_at, COALESCE($3, content_updated_at)),
             last_edited_by = CASE
                 WHEN $3::timestamptz >= GREATEST(updated_at, content_updated_at) THEN $4
                 ELSE last_edited_by
             END
         WHERE id = $1
